label: Google Sheets: Append Row
description: Append one row to a tab: pass an object keyed by the header's column names, or a plain list of cells. Emits the appended row's sheet row number.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: A Google account with write access to the sheet (the picker grant covers the file it picked).

inputs.name: spreadsheet
inputs.label: Spreadsheet
inputs.placeholder: Pick one, or paste its share link

inputs.name: tab
inputs.label: Tab
inputs.placeholder: Pick a tab, or paste a link with #gid=

inputs.name: row
inputs.description: The row to append: an object keyed by header column names ({"name": "ada", "age": "36"}), or a plain list of cells in order.

inputs.name: hasHeader
inputs.label: First row is a header
inputs.description: Needed to order an object row's columns.

outputs.name: rowNumber
outputs.description: The appended row's 1-based sheet row number.
